name: Martin Special DC Performing Artist Style Ovangkol Acoustic-Electric Guitar Gloss Sunburst
description: The Martin DC Special Performing Artist Ovangkol Dreadnought acoustic-electric guitar features a blend of the legendary Martin tone, with solid-wood construction and elegant appointments. This instrument was designed for the player searching for a fine acoustic guitar that is attractive and versatile enough to cover a variety of musical styles and performance techniques. This DC Special Performing Artist Ovangkol Dreadnought boasts a Sitka spruce top, ovangkol back and sides, mahogany neck and innovative Fishman electronics. This instrument can cover a lot of ground. Its balanced warmth and top-end power means its great for strumming chords, playing with a band or solo coffeehouse gig. The DC Special Performing Artist Ovangkol Dreadnought comes with a deluxe gig bag. Enhanced Dreadnought Body ShapeThe Martin Enhanced Dreadnought body shape is a departure from the more traditional Martin Dreadnought. Created to be a dreadnought that is more comfortable to play, the Enhanced Dreadnought body uses a shallower Auditorium (000) 4-1/8" depth. The 000 depth allows the guitar to fit snug to your body, while making it more comfortable to play. And if its tone youre after, the shallow body has all the advantage of a dreadnought, without the extra bass boom. Its tonal perfection for players looking for a dreadnought with a comfortable shape and balanced sound. Tonewood and BracingAs an African relative to rosewood, ovangkol was selected for its tonal characteristics of a balanced low end, full mid-range, and crisp top end. Ovangkol is the perfect choice for players that are searching for an all-purpose instrument that works well in a variety of musical situations. To dial in the right amount of tone and projection, the top has been braced to perfection, using Martins world renown 5/16 Forward Shifted Scalloped X Bracing Pattern.
